boundary: Source cohort is the SAME pinned V14 historical public100 set, not new independent observations. Every actor edge and normal control freezes from Tminus1 before ANY T archive read. Full V14 independently replayed control and passenger results must agree, including eight ordinary control mismatches. Observed actor/target at destination and 50KT net fuel changes are observational posthost signatures, NOT proof of activation. Fuel net differences can reflect transfers/other phases. Some initiators can be displaced by another Chunnel in the same turn, so their end location is not necessarily their own first target. Official duplicate Chunnel-target IDs choose lowest eligible full ID; prior V13 ambiguity-abstain is conservative but incomplete and is not modified here. No canonical executor promotion, mine-hit RNG attribution, combat pair predictions or Nplus1 VCR comparisons.
